سَافَرَ يُوسُفُ إِلَى مِصْرَ بِالسَّفِينَةِ.

questions.q: Oral check: answer the four questions to the teacher on camera (one by one, while others do the written check on the pupil PDF: read the text, answer three questions, label five words).
